_comment_top: spaarke-ai-architecture-redesign-r1 task 041 (FR-P3-02) — seed row for the email.draft COMMUNICATE tool. Creates a Spaarke sprk_communication DRAFT record for user review in the Communication (Email) service — explicitly NOT an Outlook draft (spec §Owner Clarifications). DRAFT-ONLY: statuscode is server-pinned to Draft(1) inside the handler; sending stays user-initiated through the Communication service (which sends via Graph); assistant-initiated send is the named FR-P4-07 deferral.
_comment_routing: Runtime invocation routes to EmailDraftToolHandler via sprk_handlerclass. Auto-discovered (ADR-010). The P2+ loop projects the LLM-facing function name from sprk_toolid; sprk_name keeps the SYS- display convention required by the seed script's safety filter.
_comment_obo: spec MUST rule: the draft record is created through IDataverseUserClient under the calling user's OBO token — a user who cannot create communications fails with their own access error; no app-only path is reachable from the handler.
_comment_side_effect: sprk_sideeffectclass = 100000002 (Communicate) — SIDE-EFFECT tool and the FIRST communicate-class consumer. The ONE confirmation gate (FR-P2-02 / SideEffectGateAIFunction) suspends/resumes this tool BY THIS DECLARED CLASS (never by tool-name list); the handler itself contains NO gating logic. Typed-handler confirm-resume is the P3 seam (FR-P3-03 note in task-037); until it lands, confirm closes the gate confirmed-unexecutable — suspend-only remains the safe posture.
_comment_grounding: source_refs carries the addressable ledger keys ({bindingId}@t{n}) and/or record citation paths the draft was composed from (e.g. the draft-correspondence capability output and the matter created earlier in the session) — identifiers only (NFR-07).
_comment_consumption: Read by scripts/Seed-TypedHandlers.ps1. Idempotent — UPSERT by sprk_handlerclass + sprk_toolcode with sprk_name 'SYS-%' filter.
_comment_description_history: G-P3 UAT round-4 R4-4 (2026-07-07): added the no-attachments rule + inline-content steering — 'send this as an email' after a combined summary produced a draft referencing an attachment that cannot exist. Mirror of the live spaarkedev1 row.
sprk_description: Creates a DRAFT email record in Spaarke's Communication service for the user to review and send. NEVER sends email — sending is always user-initiated from the Communication service. Compose the subject and body from grounded session outputs (summaries, records created this session) and cite their ledger keys in source_refs. The draft CANNOT carry attachments — never write body text that references an attached or enclosed document ('please find attached', 'enclosed is'). When the user asks to email content already produced in this conversation (a summary, findings, a comparison), include that content INLINE in the body; if their request implies attaching a file, say the email is sent without attachments and inline the material instead. Optionally associate the draft to a record via 'regarding' (e.g. the matter it concerns). COMMUNICATE tool: invocation is confirmation-gated; the record is created with the user's own privileges.
_comment_availableincontexts: 100000001 = Chat only — email.draft exists for the agent loop (P3), not playbook nodes (the frozen engine's SendEmailNodeExecutor remains the engine-side write shape).

sprk_jsonschema.title: email.draft Request
sprk_jsonschema.description: Creates a Spaarke communication DRAFT record (Communication service; NOT Outlook; DRAFT-ONLY).

body.description: Full email body text. Plain text by default; set body_format to 'html' when the body is HTML.

table.description: Logical name of the record type this draft is about (Communication-service regarding contract).

recordId.description: GUID of the regarding record — e.g. the matter created earlier this session.

name.description: Optional display name of the regarding record.

regarding.description: Optional record association for the draft.

source_refs.description: Ledger output keys ({bindingId}@t{n}) and/or record citation paths (tables/{table}/records/{guid}) the draft content was composed from. Cite every session output you used.

status.description: ALWAYS 'draft' — this tool never sends (DRAFT-ONLY invariant, server-pinned).

communicationId.description: GUID of the created sprk_communication DRAFT record (null only if Dataverse did not echo the created row).

sourceRefs.description: The ledger/record references the draft was composed from (identifiers only).

sprk_configuration._comment: No method-discriminator dispatch — single LLM-facing function. Reserved for per-environment defaults.
sprk_configuration._comment_riskprofile: Confirmation Policy v2 (FR-A1-03, task 032) catalog-declared risk factors — DATA extending sprk_sideeffectclass per policy-v2-origin-classification-decision-tree.md §1. email.draft PREPARES draft text only — no send, no system-of-record mutation ⇒ Tier 1 (draft-only). NOTE: the row's sprk_sideeffectclass stays Communicate (100000002); the CURRENT fail-closed live gate still suspends it. The Policy v2 engine consuming this DATA is where draft-only stops gating — the SEND action (a separate Tier 4 capability) always dialogs. Live behavior is unchanged until the engine is wired at the send/draft call sites (tasks 034/042).
